definitions.gloss: uncrowned; without a title or championship
definitions.explanation: Having no title, crown, or championship victory. Most commonly used in sports to describe a talented athlete or team that has never won a major title, often with a nuance of sympathy or frustrated potential.

definitions.gloss: without rank or official position; unofficial
definitions.explanation: Lacking formal recognition, credentials, or official standing, despite having the skill or reputation to warrant them.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{無冠|むかん}の{選手|せんしゅ}だ。
examples.english: He is a player without a title.

examples.japanese: {実力|じつりょく}はあるのに、いまだに{無冠|むかん}のままだ。
examples.english: Despite having the ability, he still remains without a championship.

examples.japanese: {無冠|むかん}の{帝王|ていおう}と{呼|よ}ばれたそのボクサーは、ついに{世界|せかい}タイトルを{手|て}にした。
examples.english: The boxer, who had been called the uncrowned champion, finally got his hands on the world title.

examples.japanese: {無冠|むかん}の{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}だ。
examples.english: He is a researcher without formal credentials.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}を{出|で}ていない{無冠|むかん}の{身|み}ながら、{業界|ぎょうかい}では{一目|いちもく}{置|お}かれている。
examples.english: Despite being without a degree, he is well-respected in the industry.

examples.japanese: {新聞記者|しんぶんきしゃ}は「{無冠|むかん}の{帝王|ていおう}」と{呼|よ}ばれることがある。
examples.english: Newspaper reporters are sometimes called 'uncrowned kings.'

notes:
Composed of {無|む} (without) and {冠|かん} (crown, title). The word carries a dramatic, slightly literary quality. In sports journalism, it often appears with a tone of sympathy — describing someone whose talent deserves recognition but who has not yet won a championship.

The set phrase {無冠|むかん}の{帝王|ていおう} (uncrowned king/emperor) is the most well-known usage. It has two distinct applications:
- In sports: a dominant athlete who has never won a major title
- For journalists: a traditional epithet for newspaper reporters, reflecting their power to influence public opinion despite holding no official authority

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無冠|むかん}の{帝王|ていおう}: uncrowned king/emperor
- {無冠|むかん}の{選手|せんしゅ}: player without a title
- {無冠|むかん}に{終|お}わる: to end without winning a title
- {無冠|むかん}のまま{引退|いんたい}する: to retire without a championship

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {優勝|ゆうしょう}: championship victory — what {無冠|むかん} athletes lack
- タイトル: title — the achievement being referred to
- {無名|むめい}: unknown, obscure — about fame rather than titles
